  • Method Details

    • readFromResources

      public static Optional<com.google.gson.JsonObject> readFromResources(String path)

      Reads the JSON file at the given path relative to the resources folder, and parses it into a JsonObject instance using Gson.

      Special cases:

      • Returns an empty Optional if there is no file at the given path
      • Logs an error and returns an empty Optional if an Exception is caught
      Parameters:
      path - the path to the JSON file relative to the resources folder (/folder/file.json)
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the parsed JsonObject instance, or an empty Optional if there is no file at the given path, or if an Exception is caught
      See Also:
      • Gson

    • flatten

      public static Map<String,String> flatten(com.google.gson.JsonObject json)

      Flattens the given JsonObject into a HashMap of key-value pairs.

      Example:

      {
    "text": {
        "title": "My Application",
        "credit": "by isoyigido"
    },
    "button": {
        "start": "Start",
        "settings": "Settings"
    }
}

      The JSON above would be flattened to the following key-value pairs:

      "text.title" -> "My Application"
"text.credit" -> "by isoyigido"
"button.start" -> "Start"
"button.settings" -> "Settings
      Parameters:
      json - the nested JSON object
      Returns:
      the HashMap containing the key-value pairs

    • flatten

      public static <T> Map<String,T> flatten(com.google.gson.JsonObject json, Function<String, Optional<T>> parser)

      Flattens the given JsonObject into a HashMap of key-value pairs using the given parser function to parse string values. The given parser function should return an empty Optional and preferably log a warning if the string value is invalid in any way.

      Example:

      {
    "text": {
        "title": "FFFFFF",
        "credit": "A8A8A8"
    },
    "button": {
        "start": "007BFF",
        "settings": "0A9797"
    }
}

      If the given parser function parses string representations of colors, the JSON above would be flattened to the following key-value pairs:

      "text.title" -> new Color(255, 255, 255)
"text.credit" -> new Color(168, 168, 168)
"button.start" -> new Color(0, 123, 255)
"button.settings" -> new Color(10, 151, 151)

      Special cases:

      • Skips the key-value pair if the parser function returns an empty Optional for the value
      Type Parameters:
      T - the object type of the stored values
      Parameters:
      json - the nested JSON object
      parser - the parser function used for parsing the string values
      Returns:
      the HashMap containing the key-value pairs
